allergensPage.title: Allergens and food hygiene
allergensPage.intro: What's in everything we make, and how we keep it apart. The chart and rating here are samples for this demo.
allergensPage.crossContact: Every waffle is made on the same irons and topped at one counter, so traces of nuts, soya and milk are possible in all of them. Candy floss is spun on its own machine.

blocks.heading: How it works
blocks.body:
We set up in a courtyard, a reception or a car park and serve for two or three hours. Your team pays nothing at the stall: you pay one invoice.

Send your logo and we'll print it on the napkins.

blocks.text: Tell us the day and roughly how many.

questions.a: Summer Saturdays go a couple of months ahead; weekdays are easier. Check the day on Book us.
